abstract: PURPOSE: SCT treatment in newborns consists of surgery and selective chemotherapy. Few reports document urological sequelae using this approach. This review focuses on the urological and neurourological findings following SCT treatment in the newborn period. MATERIALS AND METHODS: We reviewed the records of all infants with SCT resected in early infancy who underwent urodynamic evaluation for bladder dysfunction between 1986 and 2004. The radiological, neurological and urodynamic findings, and postoperative incontinence management were analyzed. RESULTS: We analyzed UDS of 14 patients who presented with urinary infection or incomplete bladder emptying after SCT resection. At the time of UDS an abnormal neurological examination was noted in 5 patients (36%). Detrusor overactivity was seen in 8 patients, underactivity in 2 and normal activity in 4. Abnormal urethral sphincter EMG potentials were observed in 7 of 13 patients (54%). Five of 13 patients (38%) had sphincter dyssynergia during voiding. Consequently, CIC was needed in 11 of the 14 patients (79%) to empty the bladder, of whom 5 also required anticholinergics to improve detrusor compliance and dryness. Only 3 patients voided spontaneously with normal bladder and sphincter function, of whom 2 were toilet trained. Hydronephrosis was seen in 6 patients and reflux was noted in 7 (including 5 of 6 with hydronephrosis). Antireflux surgery was performed in 6 patients, all of whom had up to grade 4 reflux due to recurrent urinary tract infection. One girl with grade 2 reflux had spontaneous resolution. CONCLUSIONS: SCT and its treatment can produce neurourological dysfunction of the lower urinary tract with high grade reflux, and abnormal bladder and urethral function. Complete assessment, including urodynamic studies, is imperative preoperatively and postoperatively. Constant vigilance is required to maintain as near normal bladder function as possible and to prevent upper urinary tract injury.
abstract_ja: 目的：仙尾部奇形腫（SCT）の新生児期の治療は、手術と選択的化学療法からなる。この治療に伴う泌尿器科的な後遺症を報告した文献は少ない。本レビューでは、新生児期のSCT治療後の泌尿器科的および神経泌尿器科的所見に焦点を当てる。対象と方法：1986年から2004年の間に、乳児期早期にSCTを切除され、膀胱機能障害の評価のために尿流動態検査を受けた全例の診療記録をレビューした。放射線学的、神経学的、尿流動態学的所見、および術後の失禁管理を解析した。結果：SCT切除後に尿路感染症または不完全な膀胱排尿を呈した14例の尿流動態検査（UDS）を解析した。UDS時に5例（36%）で神経学的検査の異常が認められた。排尿筋過活動は8例、低活動は2例、正常は4例にみられた。尿道括約筋の筋電図で異常な電位は13例中7例（54%）で認められた。13例中5例（38%）で排尿時の括約筋協調不全がみられた。その結果、14例中11例（79%）で膀胱を空にするために清潔間欠導尿（CIC）が必要であり、そのうち5例は排尿筋のコンプライアンス改善と乾燥のために抗コリン薬も必要とした。自然排尿で膀胱・括約筋機能が正常であったのは3例のみで、そのうち2例は排尿自立していた。結論：SCTとその治療は、高度の膀胱尿管逆流を伴う下部尿路の神経泌尿器科的機能障害と、膀胱・尿道機能異常を引き起こしうる。術前および術後の尿流動態検査を含む包括的な評価が不可欠である。上部尿路損傷を防ぎ、可能な限り正常に近い膀胱機能を維持するため、絶え間ない注意が必要である。
